effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. For every Digimon your opponent has in play, add 2000 to the maximum DP you can choose with this effect.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, if you have a Tamer in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP.
